page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance type does not include bundled local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support multi-node communication and data transfers. There are no integrated GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this configuration.

The resource allocation profile of the ecs.g9a.16xlarge offers a balanced distribution of compute and memory resources, making it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for workloads that do not require specialized hardware accelerators or local NVMe storage. Appropriate workloads for this instance include enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, and general-purpose database hosting.
